commands.command: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy -p quansio-tools -p quansio-server -p quansio-cli -p quansio-contracts -p quansio-machine --all-targets -- -D warnings; ruff check, ruff format --check, mypy intelligence; tsc -p apps/desktop; eslint --max-warnings 0 apps/desktop  # clean
QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<private database> cargo test -p quansio-tools -p quansio-server -p quansio-cli -p quansio-contracts -p quansio-machine --no-fail-fast  # 1041 passed, 0 failed

cargo test -p quansio-tools --test visibility --test tool_check_binary  # 16 passed: projection narrowing over every subset of a grant pool, host-only absence, caller checks, flag parsing, source scans, the quansio-tool-check binary

cargo test -p quansio-server --test tool_visibility --test outputs_preview --test intelligence_gateway --test pack_install  # 36 passed (5, 13, 5, 13) against real PostgreSQL, the real dispatcher and the real Python plane process
uv run --frozen pytest -q (python/)  # 776 passed, 93 skipped (real-boundary variables absent); includes test_pack_install and test_tool_visibility
vitest run (apps/desktop)  # 560 passed, 45 skipped; packs.test.ts 9 new

uv run --project python pytest tests/architecture tests/contract tests/ci --deselect tests/contract/test_contracts.py::test_generated_bindings_are_current  # 246 passed, 1 deselected (the Rust contract generator cannot run from a worktree; it runs in the finalize dry-run clone)
python3 scripts/validate_v81.py; arch_check; workspace_check; check_authority --check; pack_records  # clean

python3 mutation-checks.py (in this bundle; committed tree)  # 31 mutants in the final script, all KILLED after CONTROL-PASSED and COMPILES; the first run's log also holds one survivor (equivalent by layering, replaced) and four stale-pattern NO-VERDICTs that were re-run
